A container image of the app, for any kind of app (an API, a worker, a command): a multi-stage Dockerfile that builds the binary and copies it into a minimal image without a shell or root (distroless). The image runs the app's default command; give another one after the image's name, e.g. docker run &lt;image> migrate. With http, it exposes the port and checks /healthz; with compose, the app becomes a service of compose.yaml in the app profile.

```esquadro
blueprint docker
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [http](../http/), [compose](../compose/) when the app uses them.

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `docker.build` | Steps of the build stage before the binary is built, e.g. RUN lines. |
| `docker.runtime` | Lines of the final image before its entrypoint, e.g. COPY of a file. |
| `docker.compose.environment` | Variables of the app's service in compose.yaml, as YAML lines indented by six spaces, e.g. DATABASE_URL: ... |
| `docker.compose.depends_on` | Services the app's service waits for in compose.yaml, as YAML lines indented by six spaces, e.g. postgres: { condition: service_healthy }. |
